name: Squid
long_description:
We believe the electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth. If we want electrification to move fast, the teams planning and operating networks need software that is as modern as the challenge.

Our thesis is simple. Better decisions come from one unified, trusted network model. When everyone works from the same model, planning becomes consistent, assumptions are visible, and progress stops getting lost in spreadsheets and static reports.

Squid is AI powered grid planning in your browser. We have spent years inside National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS, building and learning what breaks. Now we are building what we wished existed.
one_liner: AI agents for power grid planning  🦑

launches.title: Squid 🦑 AI-powered grid planning in your browser
launches.tagline: The electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth - but planning is still file chaos. One trusted model fixes it.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Grid decisions still get made across emails, spreadsheets, PDFs, GIS exports, and conflicting model versions. [Squid](https://www.linkedin.com/company/squid-energy/) ([squid.energy](http://squid.energy)) gives utilities a single, trusted model (a live, versioned grid map of substations and lines, with evidence attached) so planning is consistent, and decisions ship faster.

### **The problem**

Most grid organisations have the tools for analysis, but the _decision trail_ is fragmented:

* models live in specialist tools
* evidence lives in decks/docs/spreadsheets
* assumptions live in people’s heads

Result: slow planning cycles, endless “which version is right?”, and hard-to-defend decisions.

### **Our solution**

Squid is a workspace where the **model of the electric grid at the center**.

* **Unify** messy grid data into one coherent model (and keep it current)
* **Version** everything so changes are trackable and comparable
* **Attach evidence + assumptions** to the model, where decisions are made
* **Run repeatable workflows** for planning, connections, and network change

### **Why now**

Electrification is accelerating and the grid is the bottleneck. The old workflow - files, handoffs, static reports - doesn’t scale to the pace of change.

### **Why us**

We’re [Conor Jones ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/conorjones-energy)and [George Kolokotronis.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-kolokotronis/) We’ve built inside **National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS** - we’ve lived the pain, and we’re building the system we wish we had.

### **Our ask**

We’re looking for **design partners** at grid operators (planning, connections, modelling, GIS, asset strategy). If that’s you - or you can intro us - please reach out: [**hello@squid.energy**](mailto:hello@squid.energy)
